definition: Player-level prior experience for each player on the locked target-season preseason OL roster; keep starts/games/snaps as distinct measures.
required_inputs: Timestamped target-season preseason roster plus stable player IDs and prior-season player-game participation or starts.
missing_data_behavior: Unknown when player or season coverage is incomplete; do not replace unknown with zero.
preseason_leakage_risk: Safe only when the target roster is captured before the cutoff and participation is restricted to earlier seasons.
relationship_to_context: Control for individual experience so shared history adds information beyond how much each player has played.
current_status: Blocked: no eligible local player-level source.

definition: Count returning OL pairs that started the same prior-season game; optionally summarize the count per eligible roster pair.
required_inputs: Locked preseason OL roster plus complete game-level offensive line starter records with stable player IDs and game IDs.
missing_data_behavior: Missing if roster or starter coverage is incomplete; zero only for a covered roster with no prior co-starts.
preseason_leakage_risk: Safe with an on-time roster and prior seasons only; does not claim same-snap overlap.
relationship_to_context: May overlap aggregate returning production and incoming-transfer inputs; test conditional association after individual starts are included.
current_status: Candidate only: reviewed CFBD endpoint schemas have no documented starts field; no local starter archive exists.

definition: Count pairs with verified prior offensive participation in the same game; label as same-game participation, not simultaneous time.
required_inputs: Locked preseason roster plus complete player-game participation rows, stable IDs, and game IDs.
missing_data_behavior: Missing if game participation is incomplete; a missing box-score stat row is not a nonappearance or zero.
preseason_leakage_risk: Safe when all evidence predates the target season; target-season depth charts or usage cannot select pairs.
relationship_to_context: Could overlap team-wide returning production; compare against individual participation and transfer inputs.
current_status: Candidate only: CFBD game player rows are box-score statistics, not a complete participation ledger.

definition: Pair-level count or share of offensive snaps on which both OL players were on the field.
required_inputs: Locked preseason roster plus player-by-play lineup or equivalent same-snap participation data.
missing_data_behavior: Missing if lineup data or either player's snap evidence is absent; never infer overlap from two season snap totals.
preseason_leakage_risk: Safe only from prior seasons and with an on-time target roster; no target-season snaps.
relationship_to_context: Likely distinct from aggregate returning production, but could correlate with it and individual prior workload.
current_status: Not measurable from the reviewed CFBD schemas or local cache.

definition: Share of the prior OL workload attributable to players present in the target preseason roster; keep team workload and pair overlap separate.
required_inputs: Locked target roster plus prior-season OL snap counts or starter workload with position-specific team denominators.
missing_data_behavior: Missing if the prior OL denominator or player roster links are incomplete; do not interpret missing denominator as zero retention.
preseason_leakage_risk: Safe if the roster snapshot is on-time and workload is from a completed prior season.
relationship_to_context: Related to team-level returning production, but the latter is not OL-specific in current Context inputs.
current_status: Not measurable: current repository sources do not provide position-specific player workload.

definition: Count prior seasons in which two players appeared on the same school's season roster; this is a roster-co-membership proxy only.
required_inputs: Historical season rosters with stable player IDs plus an on-time target-season preseason roster.
missing_data_behavior: Missing if a season roster is absent or position/identity coverage is insufficient; zero only under complete coverage.
preseason_leakage_risk: Historical roster membership is retrospective unless archived at the target cutoff; cannot stand in for preseason membership without validation.
relationship_to_context: May correlate with individual years in program, roster talent, and program history; it does not establish playing experience.
current_status: Weak fallback description only; not evidence of the line functioning together.
